correctness.rationale: The claim uses the 16 graph vertices (not the metric continuum) and inclusive shortest-path thresholds. Independent graph construction and full clique enumeration at r=2 give face vector (16,72,112,48) and mod-2 Betti numbers (0,0,9,2); degree-one at r=1 is 24−16+1=9. The inspected standalone certificate constructs 118 acyclic Forman pairs, checks its directed Hasse graph, and performs integral unit-pivot simplicial chain cancellations leaving 1 vertex, nine 2-cells, two 3-cells and zero differential. The two-cell attachments contract since no critical 1-cells and hence simply connected; trivial attaching maps of 3-cells follow from π₂(∨⁹S²)=Z⁹ and zero cellular boundary. At r=3 the 8 disjoint distance-4 pairs give (S⁰)^*8=S⁷. Checker enumerates all 96 graph automorphisms, two signed 3-cycles and traces, with χ₃=1+b, χ₂=L₂+b, trivial orientation at r=3. Rational quotient invariants and bar endpoints follow; no claim about integral torsion of quotient.

value.rationale: The Möbius–Kantor graph is a canonical highly symmetric cubic graph. A full integral Rips homotopy filtration and degree-wise automorphism characters (including simultaneous 2- and 3-dimensional homology and a scale-3 7-sphere) are natural equivariant-persistent topology invariants. This is more than Euler characteristic or a routine graph Betti calculation; exact finite graph classification is independently useful as a benchmark.
